text: APPROVE: `IsAlsoSetLive` is now a single `||` expression, and the extracted `IsSetLiveInDirection` scores about 11 by my estimate. The behaviour is the same, because the old `break` only ended the inner loop and moved on to the other direction, which the new `return false` plus `||` reproduces with the same -1-then-1 order. The patch adds no unused code or new public API that would trip warnings-as-errors, though I have not run the build.
